title: "Fate Chess Game"
next_chapter_hook: Just as Chen Ji fell into deep contemplation, the first page of the Tianji Record suddenly gleamed with a blood-red light. Mo Xiansheng's voice suddenly turned grave—for the words he had yet to finish were precisely the most crucial link to breaking the chess game.

text.content: Night fell like ink. In the Forbidden Grounds of the Tianqing Sect Back Mountain, Chen Ji sat alone on a withered stone, spiritual energy flowing slowly around his body. The Tianji Record Fragment hovered before his knees, its yellowed pages flickering uncertainly under the moonlight, as if responding to some distant call. It was a stirring from the depths of his bloodline—a seemingly invisible thread extending from the depths of the Holy Sect Forbidden Grounds, gently touching memories he had sealed for years.

dialogue.content: You felt it. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul slowly materialized from the first page of the Tianji Record, his illusory figure swaying like candlelight in the night. His voice was hoarse and ancient, carrying the weariness of ten thousand years, "That is the resonance of the Heavenly Fate Key—someone is trying to locate you."

text.content: Chen Ji's brow center slightly furrowed as his fingertips lightly touched the cover of the Tianji Record, and the call from the depths of his bloodline gradually subsided. His heart was clear as a mirror—that was his sister, Chen Nian, who had been missing for years. The girl taken by the Holy Sect, used as the key to unlocking the full power of the Tianji Record. Nian'er, wait for me.

dialogue.content: First, do not be hasty in seeking her. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul drifted before Chen Ji, and an unprecedented solemnity appeared on his illusory face, "There are things you must know first. Otherwise, you will not even qualify to step onto this chess game."

text.content: Chen Ji raised his eyes, the gleam in them flashing and disappearing. Chess game? This was already the countless time he had heard this word from Mo Xiansheng. The Tianji Record, the Eye of Heavenly Dao, the three great sects, the Demonic Path invasion—all clues pointed to the same answer. He drew a deep breath, suppressed the surging thoughts in his heart, and spoke calmly.

dialogue.content: Speak. Chen Ji's voice was cold and still as water, as if discussing something that had nothing to do with him, "I am already prepared—however ridiculous that truth may be."

Heaven and earth are the chessboard, all living beings are the pieces. Mo Xiansheng's figure suddenly swelled, transforming into a shadow that covered half the mountain. His voice was like thunder from the Nine Heavens, making Chen Ji's eardrums ache, "This is not a metaphor—this is fact. In ancient times, the Heavenly Dao collapsed, and its fragmented will transformed into the Eye of Heavenly Dao. He took heaven and earth as the chessboard, all living things as the pieces, weaving a net of fate that covered all realms!"

text.content: Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply. He had countless times speculated on what the truth might look like, yet he had never imagined it would be like this—so grand, and so despairing. All living beings across the realms were merely pieces on a chessboard. And what was he? A piece being maneuvered, or...

dialogue.content: You ask yourself what you are? Mo Xiansheng's illusory form looked down at him, and there was a rare compassion in those ancient eyes, "You are the only variable in this ten-thousand-year chess game. The Tianji Record was set down as a piece by Him, and you—the one chosen by the Tianji Record—are the only existence capable of overturning the entire board. Therefore, He wants to kill you."

text.content: The night wind rose suddenly, rustling Chen Ji's robes. He stood still in the wind, his face betraying no emotion, only the white-knuckled fists clenched at his sides. Variable. The only existence capable of overturning the board. How ironic—this Outer Disciple/Servant deemed as waste was actually the greatest threat to this heavenly chess game.

dialogue.content: You think playing dumb and hiding your strength can deceive Him? Mo Xiansheng's voice turned sharp, his illusory figure twisting violently, "The Eye of Heavenly Dao is everywhere, knows all! He uses the prophets of generations as pieces, uses the Tianji Record as a piece—do you think your layouts over these years are unknown to the gods? He is merely waiting, waiting for you to grow to the point of being sufficiently delicious!"

text.content: Chen Ji slowly closed his eyes, and countless images flashed through his mind—the conflicts among the three great sects, the Demonic Path invasion, the opening of the Ancient Forbidden Land, every web he had secretly woven, every victory from playing dumb. All of this, it turned out, had merely been playing out within that invisible eye. He was watching Chen Ji's performance, watching his自以为是的挣扎—like watching an ant fruitlessly climbing on a chessboard.

dialogue.content: So what? Chen Ji opened his eyes, and a faint cold smile actually curved his lips. That smile was chilling to the heart, "Since He's watching, let Him watch His fill. I want to see just how magnificent His expression will be when I overturn this board."

Fine courage. Mo Xiansheng's illusory form steadied, and there was even a hint of approval in his tone, but it immediately turned heavy, "However, overturning the board is far from easy. The Eye of Heavenly Dao's power far exceeds your imagination—though He is merely a fragmentary will from the collapse of the ancient Heavenly Dao, He still controls more than thirty percent of the法则之力 of this realm. If you forcibly resist, you will only end up with your soul scattered."

text.content: Chen Ji was silent for a moment, then suddenly asked: "Can faking death get me off the board?" Mo Xiansheng's figure slightly faltered, then let out a low laugh. The laughter was full of bitterness and helplessness, as if mocking the naivety of an ignorant child.

dialogue.content: Fake death? Mo Xiansheng's illusory form shook his head and sighed, "Do you think what the Eye of Heavenly Dao controls is what? It is fate! It is cause and effect! As long as He exists, as long as you remain within this realm, you will always be on His board. Faking death can only temporarily free you from observation on the board—but if the Eye of Heavenly Dao is willing, He can pull you back into the game at any moment, and will settle your debts of cause and effect with compounded interest!"

text.content: Chen Ji listened quietly, his expression unchanged. He should have known—a being at the level of the Eye of Heavenly Dao could never be deceived by something as trivial as a fake death plan. This game was far more despairing than he had imagined. But in the depths of his eyes, something was slowly burning.

choice.prompt: Faced with this nearly unsolvable predicament, Chen Ji must make a choice. How should he respond to this destined-to-fail war?

choices.description: Since it is a chess game, respond with the ways of a chess game. Continue to secretly lay plans, weave a web so intricate that even the Eye of Heavenly Dao cannot see through it, and seek weaknesses in the board.
choices.visible_cost: "Expend a large amount of Heavenly Fate to perform Tianji Record deduction"
choices.visible_reward: Obtain the雏形 of the "Chess Game Insight" ability, allowing one to glimpse the hidden currents within the chess game
choices.risk_hint: Every move of laying plans is carried out under the watchful gaze of the Eye of Heavenly Dao, which may expose more weaknesses

text.content: Very well. Mo Xiansheng slightly nodded, his illusory form gradually fading, leaving only one final sentence echoing in the night sky, "Remember, you are the variable—the meaning of a variable lies in being controlled by no one, including fate itself."

choices.description: Before thoroughly understanding the rules, acting rashly only makes you die faster. Pull back all layouts, continue to hide behind the废物 persona, and wait for the opportunity.
choices.visible_cost: Temporarily abandon all opportunities for主动进攻
choices.visible_reward: Preserve the complete Heavenly Fate and all trump cards, allowing one to unleash all strength at a critical moment
choices.risk_hint: Passive waiting may give the enemy more preparation time, and the variable may also be gradually worn down

text.content: Chen Ji slowly收敛ed his surrounding aura, once again becoming that ordinary servant disciple appearance. But in the depths of his eyes, that flame not only did not extinguish, it burned even more fiercely. Concealment has always been for the sake of a more powerful explosion.

choices.text: "Burn Heavenly Fate, burn together with the chess"
choices.description: Use oneself as the price, forcibly ignite the complete power of the Tianji Record, attempt to overturn the board in one go. Extremely dangerous, but may tear open a gap.

text.content: Chen Ji raised his hand, and the Tianji Record Fragment suddenly burst forth with dazzling golden light. A strand of blood trickled from the corner of his mouth, yet his eyes held a resolute smile—if this board is destined to be stained with blood, then let it bleed to its heart's content!

At the moment Chen Ji made his choice, the first page of the Tianji Record suddenly erupted with an ominous blood-red glow. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul recondensed, and this time his form was more solid than before, an unprecedented solemnity appearing on his ancient face.

dialogue.content: You have made your choice, very well. But Mo Xiansheng's voice was low and grave, as if the following words carried the weight of a thousand jun, "No matter which path you choose, there is one thing you must know—the sole ultimate condition for breaking the chess game."

text.content: The night wind ceased abruptly, and the world fell into deathly silence. Chen Ji raised his eyes to look at that illusory figure, awaiting fate's judgment. Mo Xiansheng's illusory form slowly raised one hand, pointing to Chen Ji's heart.

dialogue.content: A piece that voluntarily relinquishes the "variable" identity is needed. Mo Xiansheng's voice was like an ancient bell, exploding in Chen Ji's mind, "Only when a variable willingly gives up his special nature, reintegrating himself into the operation of the chess game—will cracks appear in the Eye of Heavenly Dao's control over the board. And you, as the variable itself... this sacrifice... must be made by you."

text.content: Chen Ji stood quietly in the night wind, his expression as usual, only a faint wave passing through the depths of his eyes. Relinquishing the variable's identity—means relinquishing the ability to overturn the board, relinquishing the possibility of breaking fate, relinquishing... everything. He suddenly thought of the girl deep in the Holy Sect Forbidden Grounds, remembered her gaze, resilient despite years of captivity. Nian'er is still waiting for him. He cannot fall, cannot give up. But the answer fate gave was so cruel.

choice.prompt: The truth of the ultimate condition lies before him—breaking the board's price is to abandon oneself. How will Chen Ji choose?

choices.description: The so-called condition is merely another form of manipulation by the Eye of Heavenly Dao. The reason a variable is a variable lies in its ability to break all established rules—including the conditions it sets itself.
choices.visible_cost: May be locked onto early by the Eye of Heavenly Dao
choices.visible_reward: Preserve the variable identity, preserve all possibilities
choices.risk_hint: Refusing the established conditions may provoke the Eye of Heavenly Dao and bring more frantic pursuit

text.content: "My fate is determined by me, not by heaven." Chen Ji's voice echoed in the night sky, calm yet firm enough to chill the heart, "Does it want me to act according to its rules? Then I will break its rules—including this so-called ultimate condition."

choices.text: "If sacrifice is truly needed, I will consider it"
choices.description: In order to break this ten-thousand-year chess game, in order to free all living beings from being maneuvered—if someone truly needs to sacrifice... why shouldn't that person be him?
choices.visible_cost: May lose everything, including life and memories
choices.visible_reward: If successful, will completely break the Eye of Heavenly Dao's control, granting all people true freedom
choices.risk_hint: Voluntarily relinquishing the variable identity may lead to irreversible consequences

text.content: Mo Xiansheng's figure slightly trembled, and a flicker of emotion actually passed through his illusory eyes. He seemed to want to say something, but ultimately merely sighed softly: "...You will regret this. But perhaps, precisely because you would think this way, it proves you are truly the only variable in this ten-thousand-year chess game."

choices.memory_label: 陈机的牺牲意向被墨先生记录

text.content: At this moment, the blood-red glow on the first page of the Tianji Record suddenly surged. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul twisted violently, as if under enormous pressure. His voice became fragmented: "He... He is peering... You must... before He locks onto you... make a decision..."

dialogue.content: A will surpassing all language descended abruptly upon the Tianqing Sect Back Mountain. That was not a voice, not a gaze, but a pure, overwhelming presence pressing down. Chen Ji felt his blood and qi churning wildly, as if an invisible eye was piercing through his flesh, bones, and bloodline, gazing directly into the deepest part of his soul—the Eye of Heavenly Dao. He had come.

text.content: Chen Ji forced himself not to kneel, his jaw clenched tight, a trickle of blood seeping from the corner of his mouth. His consciousness was nearly torn apart in that instant, yet he死死守住 his mind, refusing to let that peering enter his core memories. The Tianji Record trembled violently against his chest, as if shielding its master from something. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul had faded to near invisibility, yet still erected a illusory barrier at the final moment.

dialogue.content: Get lost. Chen Ji's voice was hoarse and low, yet carried undeniable resolve. He slowly raised his head, gazing directly at that invisible peering, and a mocking弧度 actually curved his lips, "Want to see my trump cards? Fine, I'll show you—but after you see them, don't you dare regret it."

text.content: The Tianji Record suddenly burst forth with dazzling golden light, and countless ancient runes poured forth from its pages, weaving an impenetrable shield around Chen Ji. The pressure of the peering suddenly loosened—the surpassing will seemed to choose retreat at this moment—or perhaps, reassessing this seemingly weak piece. The night wind rose once more, carrying away the lingering oppression in the air. Chen Ji knelt on one knee, gasping heavily, sweat and blood mingling as they dripped from his jaw onto the withered grass.

That was close. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul barely reformed, his voice weak and barely audible, "He... He has retreated for now, but He has marked you. From now on, no matter where you are, He can sense your general location. This game... has just begun." Chen Ji slowly rose to his feet, raising his head to gaze at the cold, bright moon in the night sky. In the depths of his eyes, that flame not only did not extinguish, it burned even more fiercely. What of the Eye of Heavenly Dao? If you want to play chess, then let's play to the fullest. He, Chen Ji, has never feared any opponent—even if that opponent is Heaven itself.
